brief:
An Israeli driver reportedly ran over eight Palestinians at five different locations in Kafr Qasim on Wednesday, Middle East Eye reported. Four of the injured were women. The incidents appeared to be deliberate, according to the account.

The attack occurred in the Arab town of Kafr Qasim, located inside Israel's 1948 borders. All eight Palestinians sustained injuries from the vehicle strikes.
dek: Israeli driver reportedly runs over eight Palestinians in Kafr Qasim Eight Palestinians, including four women, were injured on Wednesday when an Israeli settler reportedly deliberately ran them over at five different locations in Kafr Qassem.
title: Israeli driver runs over eight Palestinians in Kafr Qasim
